base.source: measured on the built approved ship (2026-11-23)

C2.label: C2 cluster 30 m aft on a longer thrust truss

C3.label: C3 C2 + 6 m spool (burn 12 m aft of the shield), ribbon loops, tank-shadowing shields

C4.label: C4 C3 + braking protection package (15 m screen zone)

problems.title: Compact engine hardware absorbs most of the burn
problems.mechanism: Loops, shield and closure coils within 2-12 m of a 65 TW burn see most of its sky and take 46-69 % of the charged products
problems.required: Piped heat <= 10.8 GW (four engines, the canon drive radiators)
problems.assumptions: V2 optimistic fuel (1.6B S5), vacuum test particles, ron.py sky ledger
problems.solutions: Stronger closure field (x4 already used in C3), ribbon loops, larger loop radii within the cluster envelope, lower-loss fuel cycle
problems.advances: Absorbed fraction 4e-5 of fusion power (today about 0.45); a field that keeps charged products off hardware at 2-10 m
problems.next: Hybrid PIC of the compact burn with C1-C2 closure coils at x4 field

problems.title: Compact axial efficiency 0.31-0.51 inflates the mass ratio
problems.mechanism: Products hitting the shield and leaving radially do not make thrust; ve falls with eta
problems.achieved: C1 0.31, C3 0.51; departure 48,744 t even if the heat closed
problems.assumptions: Test particles, 48 directions x 4 species (quick run)
problems.solutions: Field x4 and burn 12 m aft of the shield (C3) raise eta 0.31 to 0.51

problems.title: Burns light the radiator blades and the aft ship
problems.mechanism: Shadow cones of the drawn shields (28 deg) do not cover the spine, the tank dome or the blade roots beside the cluster
problems.required: <= 0.1 GW direct burn on the ship
problems.achieved: C1 1,255 GW; C2 76 GW (cluster 30 m aft); C4 13.9 GW, all on the blade aft ends
problems.assumptions: No ship self-occlusion; photons + neutrons; four canted burns
problems.solutions: Cluster 30 m aft (16x less), tank-shadowing shields (C3/C4), move the blade aft station forward or cant the blade aft ends edge-on
problems.advances: None for C4: a geometry change of the blade aft station (PROTOTYPE) closes most of the remainder

problems.title: Loop windings take 7,000 x their neutron fluence limit
problems.mechanism: Windings 7.6 m from the burn behind 0.22 m of armour (drawn)
problems.assumptions: W-B4C attenuation 0.08 m, scattered floor 1e-4 (MPN rule)
problems.solutions: No armour thickness closes: the scattered floor alone is 11 x the limit. Replaceable loop cassettes (one set per burn, about 11 exchanges per mission), or a winding farther from the burn
problems.advances: Radiation-tolerant conductor at 34e22 n/m2 with thicker armour; or neutron-lean fuel
problems.next: Neutron transport for the compact loop armour

problems.title: Engine faces lead in braking: armour only
problems.mechanism: Loops, shield faces and the hub lead into the dust in braking; nothing can stand ahead of them in the burn view
problems.achieved: Armour 8-10 cm W/C: 444 t NOMINAL, 780 t JUSTIFIED (whole aft end)
problems.solutions: Replaceable armour tiles on the loop aft faces and the hub cap (C4)
problems.next: Tile layout on the loop cryostats

problems.title: Compact stern screens close for the tank dome (NOMINAL)
problems.mechanism: Three screens in a 15 m zone ahead of the tank dome, inside the enlarged shields' shadow
problems.achieved: 0.086 events NOMINAL with 5.5 t; JUSTIFIED needs more stand-off
problems.solutions: Screens become roll-fed spares; armour remains the JUSTIFIED answer
problems.next: JUSTIFIED screen count vs shield size

problems.title: Hull-shadowing shields grow and add engine heat
problems.mechanism: Shadowing the tank dome from a burn 24 m off axis needs a 40-46 deg shield; it adds sky (heat) and mass
problems.required: Shadow the ship without extra heat
problems.achieved: C3 shield r 7.9 m (375 t/engine); C4 r 9.5 m (533 t/engine)
problems.solutions: One cluster-wide shadow disc on the hub instead of four large cones (to study)

problems.title: Longer thrust truss and feeds (30-36 m)
problems.mechanism: Cluster moved aft on twelve truss members; feeds, trunks and the Li/cold loops lengthen
problems.required: Carries 21.8 MN and the field loads
problems.achieved: Drawn, not sized (30 t per engine allotted)
problems.next: Truss FE with the cluster load cases

problems.title: Ripple heating of the compact eddy shields
problems.required: Radiated by the shield at <= 2,300 K
